description: Price the customer's 3D file (STL, 3MF, STEP or OBJ) and show it in ply's card. Without a file, shows the card with an upload button (with sourceUrl: the model page to download it from). In ChatGPT, pass a file the customer attached. Pass `path` (from an earlier result) to change options for a file already priced.

color.description: Color name, e.g. black, white, red (default black)

file.description: A 3D file the customer attached in this chat

fileName.description: The file's name, with a path

material.description: Material name or id, e.g. PLA, PETG, ASA, TPU (default PLA).

path.description: The file's ply path from an earlier price_file result

process.description: fdm = plastic (default); resin = fine detail (miniatures, figurines, smooth looks)

sourceUrl.description: The model page the customer picked (they download the file there and drop it in the card)

strength.description: Plastic parts only. Default balanced; strong for parts under load

units.description: Units of an STL/OBJ file, which doesn't say (default mm). Use in if the part comes out 25x too small.

name: price_file
title: Price a 3D file
